name: Meghalaya Goat Farming Scheme
benefit: 1. 50% of project cost supported (5% by applicant, 45% by Government) 1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 24 months 1. Credit linkage through partnered banks 1. Technical training and capacity building 1. Veterinary and farm management support 1. Market linkage for selling output 1. Mentorship and business advisory
_eligibility_text: **Individuals** 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The entrepreneur should possess land, either self-owned or on lease, verified by the competent authority. 1. The entrepreneur should possess a training certificate on the sector applied for from a recognized Institution, preferably from a Government Institute. 1. The Preference for availing loans will be given to entrepreneurs and entities with prior experience of undertaking Goatery. 1. The entrepreneur should have access to adequate and quality feed for the goats. 1. The entrepreneur should have a vaccination Scheme in place for the goats. 1. The entrepreneur should have a plan for marketing the goats and their products. 1. The entrepreneurs village should be in an area where goat rearing is feasible. 1. The distance between the entrepreneur’s village and the nearest market must be reasonable. 1. The entrepreneur should not be a credit defaulter from any bank. **Registered Entities** 1.
